description: Key to mature larvae of Thai species of subgenus Montisimulium (Takaoka et al. 2019, p. 64). Larvae of S. phahompokense and S. surachaii are unknown.

title: Thailand: Simulium (Nevermannia) mature larvae
description: Key to mature larvae of 10 Thai species of subgenus Nevermannia (Takaoka et al. 2019, pp. 65-66). Larva of S. chiangklangense is unknown.

title: Thailand: Simulium (Simulium) females
description: Key to adult females of 53 Thai species of subgenus Simulium s. str. (Takaoka et al. 2019, pp. 66-68). Female of S. thailandicum is unknown.

title: Thailand: Simulium (Simulium) males
description: Key to adult males of 53 Thai species of subgenus Simulium s. str. (Takaoka et al. 2019, pp. 68-69). Males of S. barnesi, S. bullatum, S. triglobus, S. kiewmaepanense and S. umphangense are unknown.

title: Thailand: Simulium (Simulium) pupae
description: Key to pupae of 53 Thai species of subgenus Simulium s. str. (Takaoka et al. 2019, pp. 69-71). Pupae of S. barnesi and S. umphangense are unknown.

title: Thailand: Simulium (Simulium) mature larvae
description: Key to mature larvae of 53 Thai species of subgenus Simulium s. str. (Takaoka et al. 2019, pp. 71-75). Larvae of S. barnesi, S. chanyae, S. kiewmaepanense, S. phukaense, S. setsukoae, S. takense, S. thailandicum and S. umphangense are unknown.

title: Thailand (2004): subgenera of Simulium (females)
description: Historical baseline key (3 couplets) to 4 subgenera of Simulium s.l. in Thailand (females). Excludes Montisimulium (female of S. (M.) sp. G unknown) and Asiosimulium (erected in 2005). Superseded by Takaoka et al. 2019.

title: Thailand (2004): subgenera of Simulium (males)
description: Historical baseline key (3 couplets) to 4 subgenera of Simulium s.l. in Thailand (males). Excludes Montisimulium (male of S. (M.) sp. G unknown) and Asiosimulium (erected in 2005). Superseded by Takaoka et al. 2019.

title: Thailand (2004): subgenera of Simulium (pupae)
description: Historical baseline key (3 couplets) to 4 subgenera of Simulium s.l. in Thailand (pupae). Excludes Montisimulium (pupa of S. (M.) sp. G unknown) and Asiosimulium (erected in 2005). Superseded by Takaoka et al. 2019.

title: Thailand (2004): subgenera of Simulium (mature larvae)
description: Historical baseline key (4 couplets) to 5 subgenera of Simulium s.l. in Thailand (mature larvae), including Montisimulium. Excludes Asiosimulium (erected in 2005). Superseded by Takaoka et al. 2019.

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Daviesellum) females
description: Key (1 couplet) to adult females of the 2 Thai species of subgenus Daviesellum (S. courtneyi and S. pahangense).

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Daviesellum) males
description: Key (1 couplet) to adult males of the 2 Thai species of subgenus Daviesellum (S. courtneyi and S. pahangense).

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Daviesellum) pupae

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Daviesellum) mature larvae
description: Key (1 couplet) to mature larvae of the 2 Thai species of subgenus Daviesellum (S. courtneyi and S. pahangense).

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Gomphostilbia) females
description: Historical baseline key (9 couplets) to adult females of 10 Thai species of Gomphostilbia (female of S. gombakense was unknown and omitted). Check update notes for later re-identifications (S. decuplum, S. parahiyangum).

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Gomphostilbia) males
description: Historical baseline key (10 couplets) to adult males of 11 Thai species of Gomphostilbia. Check update notes for later re-identifications and splits (S. decuplum, S. parahiyangum, S. gombakense).

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Gomphostilbia) pupae
description: Historical baseline key (10 couplets) to pupae of 11 Thai species of Gomphostilbia. Check update notes for later re-identifications and splits.

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Gomphostilbia) mature larvae
description: Historical baseline key (10 couplets) to mature larvae of 11 Thai species of Gomphostilbia. Check update notes for later re-identifications and splits.

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Nevermannia) females
description: Historical baseline key (2 couplets) to adult females of 3 Thai species of Nevermannia. Thai S. caudisclerum was later recognized as S. chomthongense.

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Nevermannia) males
description: Historical baseline key (2 couplets) to adult males of 3 Thai species of Nevermannia. Thai S. caudisclerum was later recognized as S. chomthongense.

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Nevermannia) pupae
description: Historical baseline key (2 couplets) to pupae of 3 Thai species of Nevermannia. Thai S. caudisclerum was later recognized as S. chomthongense.

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Nevermannia) mature larvae
description: Historical baseline key (2 couplets) to mature larvae of 3 Thai species of Nevermannia. Thai S. caudisclerum was later recognized as S. chomthongense.

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Simulium) females
description: Historical baseline key (23 couplets) to adult females of 26 Thai species of Simulium s.str. (females of S. baimaii and S. thailandicum unknown and omitted). S. chiangmaiense, S. nakhonense and S. quinquestriatum are not separated (couplet 7a). Check update notes for Thai S. nobile and S. rufibasis.

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Simulium) males
description: Historical baseline key (21 couplets) to adult males of 24 Thai species of Simulium s.str. (males of S. baimaii, S. barnesi, S. suchariti and S. triglobus unknown and omitted). S. chiangmaiense, S. nakhonense and S. thailandicum are not separated (couplet 15b).

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Simulium) pupae
description: Historical baseline key (26 couplets) to pupae of 27 Thai species of Simulium s.str. (pupa of S. barnesi unknown and omitted; includes S. baimaii placed in Simulium s.str. for convenience).

title: Thailand (2004): Simulium (Simulium) mature larvae
description: Historical baseline key (23 couplets) to mature larvae of 25 Thai species of Simulium s.str. (larvae of S. barnesi, S. chaliowae and S. thailandicum unknown and omitted). S. fenestratum and S. malayense are not separated (couplet 10b; printed as fensestratum).

title: Thailand: Simulium asakoae species-group (females)
description: Key to adult females of 21 of the 27 Thai species of the Simulium (Gomphostilbia) asakoae species-group (Takaoka et al. 2020, pp. 141-142; 20 couplets). Females of S. banluangense, S. chaowaense, S. kiewfinense, S. phapeungense, S. rampae and S. teerachanense are unknown.

title: Thailand: Simulium asakoae species-group (males)
description: Key to adult males of 26 of the 27 Thai species of the Simulium (Gomphostilbia) asakoae species-group (Takaoka et al. 2020, pp. 142-144; 22 couplets). Male of S. songense is unknown.

title: Thailand: Simulium asakoae species-group (pupae)
description: Key to pupae of Thai species of the Simulium (Gomphostilbia) asakoae species-group (Takaoka et al. 2020, pp. 144-145; 13 couplets). Ten species are indistinguishable at couplet 12a (and pupae of S. kiewfinense and S. nanthaburiense also match 12a though omitted from the printed list).

title: Thailand: Simulium asakoae species-group (mature larvae)
description: Key to mature larvae of 21 of the 27 Thai species of the Simulium (Gomphostilbia) asakoae species-group (Takaoka et al. 2020, pp. 145-146; 21 couplets; S. inthanonense keys out twice as morph 1 and morph 2). Larvae of S. banluangense, S. kiewfinense, S. maelanoiense, S. nanthaburiense, S. puaense and S. songense are unknown.

title: Simulium varicorne species-group (females)
description: Key to adult females of 14 species of the Simulium (Gomphostilbia) varicorne species-group (Srisuka et al. 2022, p. 9; 13 couplets), including S. khelangense sp. nov. from Thailand. Female of S. breviflagellum (Vietnam) is unknown and omitted.

title: Subgenus Asiosimulium: adult females
description: Updated key to adult females of 8 of the 9 known species of subgenus Asiosimulium (Srisuka et al. 2024, p. 15; 7 couplets), including S. kittipati sp. nov. and S. khongchiamense. Female of S. shanense (Myanmar) is unknown.

title: Subgenus Asiosimulium: adult males
description: Updated key to adult males of 8 of the 9 known species of subgenus Asiosimulium (Srisuka et al. 2024, pp. 15-16; 7 couplets), including S. kittipati sp. nov. and S. khongchiamense. Male of S. suchitrae (Nepal) is unknown.

title: Subgenus Asiosimulium: pupae
description: Updated key to pupae of 8 of the 9 known species of subgenus Asiosimulium (Srisuka et al. 2024, p. 16; 6 couplets), including S. kittipati sp. nov. and S. khongchiamense. S. oblongum and S. phurueaense are not separated at couplet 5a; pupa of S. shanense is unknown.

title: Subgenus Asiosimulium: mature larvae
description: Updated key to mature larvae of 8 of the 9 known species of subgenus Asiosimulium (Srisuka et al. 2024, p. 16; 7 couplets), including S. kittipati sp. nov. and S. khongchiamense. Larva of S. shanense is unknown.

title: Genera of Simuliidae in the Southern Hemisphere (Dumbleton 1963)
description: Separates Cnephia (broad sense), Gigantodax, Austrosimulium and Simulium using adult, pupal and larval characters together. Historic: many Southern Hemisphere 'Cnephia' are now in other genera.

title: Subgenera and species-groups of Austrosimulium (Dumbleton 1963)
description: Subgenera Austrosimulium and Paraustrosimulium (now a separate genus) and the bancrofti, furiosum, australense, ungulatum and mirabile groups, with the species included in each.
